proposer_development.domain: Q (rational coefficients; transcendental CONST_BANK slots are numerical-only by construction)
proposer_development.representation: v0 16-word bytecode, r7 output, CONST_BANK pinned
proposer_development.certificate: P42 exact_certificate (unified symbols, explicit domain, pole freedom); numerical evidence is never a success

source.pipeline: P30 source-group-separated splits; no natural-language data in the loop

task_generator.procedure: deterministic polynomial sampler, degree <= 2, rational coefficients with denominator dividing 12, constant term in [-10, 10], deduplicated by canonical form
task_generator.note: exact task list materializes at experiment time and is sealed then; procedure above is frozen

splits.policy: frozen before any training; source record plus all equivalences/variations of the same canonical target share one group
splits.grouping_rule: same canonical polynomial form and same source template share a group id assigned before splitting

baselines: genetic evolution baseline at equal total cost (wall-clock and candidate budgets)

final_test.forbidden_note: P38-observed final test is never reused; materialization happens at confirmation time by the frozen procedure

scientific_campaign.problem: erdos-straus bounded instances (later campaign, separate scope)
scientific_campaign.certificate: exact integer triple (x, y, z), dual checkers (integer identity and rational equation)
scientific_campaign.bounds: M <= 10^9 strict on max(x, y, z); out-of-bound finalists rejected, never certified
scientific_campaign.baseline: matched CPU enumeration of the same space and order, equal wall-clock
scientific_campaign.calibration_note: already observed in P39; pipeline validation only, no discovery claims
scientific_campaign.coverage_policy: bounded windows declared in the campaign manifest before each run; published with results; a finite miss is never a counterexample

hypothesis.statement: Under equal total cost, the structured/conditioned proposer achieves a higher exact-certificate rate (or lower median time-to-certified) than the matched classical baseline on sealed tasks of the nominated family.
hypothesis.effect: certified success rate gain or time-to-certified reduction at equal wall-clock and candidate budgets
hypothesis.falsification: If the paired bootstrap 95% CI of the rate difference includes zero or favors the baseline, the hypothesis is rejected for this family; no post-hoc metric substitution is allowed.

known.reference: tests/test_verifier_l2.py exact quadratic fixture (cited, not copied)
P31 strict certificate record (cited, not copied)

false.expected: numerical_evidence only, never a training positive

false.description: symbol-hypothesis mismatch (program in y vs target in x)
pole-in-domain rational (x^2 - 1)/(x - 1) on a domain containing x = 1

thresholds.note: quantities are frozen; numeric values require human mathematical review

non_claims: reusing infrastructure does not establish model transfer between the two scopes
a narrow-family win does not replace H1
a finite miss is never a counterexample
catalogue membership is never a novelty proof

human_review.scope: nomination + thresholds (P47); P46 curation review still pending
human_review.gate_note: P48 is blocked until a mathematician approves this nomination; this audit cannot grant approval.

frozen.procedure: sha256 over canonical JSON (sort_keys) of the nomination excluding this frozen block
